name: TITAN COMPACT: Premier Augmented Combat League
description: The regulated, corporate-sanctioned answer to underground bloodsport, the TITAN COMPACT is a one-on-one augmented combat league governed by the Meridian Combat Sports Authority — a HelixCorp subsidiary — with strict medical oversight, standardized augment classifications, and a tiered weight-and-chrome system that attempts to create fair matchups between differently augmented competitors. Fighters compete in a circular hardened arena with medical extraction systems built into the floor, and the sport has produced several genuine celebrity athletes whose chrome loadouts are as famous as their fight records. The Compact's championship event fills the Calumet Grand Arena and generates the largest single-event betting market in GLMZ.
story_hooks: A TITAN COMPACT fighter discovers that her contract's medical data clause gives HelixCorp the right to share her neural and physical health records with undisclosed third parties — and someone has been using that data to bet against her.
A Shelf bookmaker running an unofficial parallel betting market on TITAN COMPACT outcomes has been consistently beating the HelixCorp odds for two years, and someone corporate wants to know how.

A retired TITAN COMPACT champion turned commentator receives anonymous evidence that the fight that ended her career — ruled an accident — was a deliberate setup to protect a betting position held by a Compact board member.
